context: All declarations below are newly added in this synthetic PR. The caller uses a customer lookup key and the returned customer record in the same flow. No external callers exist. Team vocabulary: customer is the business entity; client is an outbound protocol client.
All listed functions are new. Audit records every attempt, including disabled ones. Emit returns its error unchanged. Calls may have observable effects; preserve order and call counts.

This new import loop both interprets the CSV row format and persists each customer. The row-to-customer interpretation is a distinct format boundary; the loop owns iteration/persistence. Store.Save order and fail-fast behavior are intentional. These are all callers.

New functions. Each address pipeline stage returns a string with a different representation. For SortInPlace the caller deliberately observes the input slice's reordered backing array; the in-place behavior is part of its API.

The adapter and consumer code shown is the complete source universe. Everything is internal to this repository. UsersFacade adds no behavior, compatibility, ownership, or substitution boundary; its callers already depend on Repository. RemoteStore wraps a network dependency and deliberately adds error context.

All functions are newly added. Pricing owns one shared free-shipping threshold, used in checkout and the cart message; they must change together. Purchasing and supplier onboarding own independent credit policies and can evolve separately.

All callers are included. The module already uses DeliveryOptions to express these two independent delivery choices at its HTTP boundary. sendInvoice is internal; its positional booleans obscure the same contract at its call sites. No rule requires options for every function.

A single queue-tier policy owns the queue name, retry limit, and burst size below. Adding or changing an already-supported tier requires coordinated edits in all three switches. All consumers are shown. Independent loyalty and authorization concepts may use the same words but are not owned by that policy.
